FuckFile Office Viewer - bundled runtime notices

The Office viewer is an offline browser-based viewer. The following third-party
components are fetched at build time at pinned versions and copied into the app
bundle; documents are not uploaded to any service.

- docx-preview 0.4.0 — Apache License 2.0
  https://github.com/VolodymyrBaydalka/docxjs
- JSZip 3.10.1 — MIT OR GPL-3.0-or-later
  https://github.com/Stuk/jszip
- @aiden0z/pptx-renderer 1.2.4 — Apache License 2.0
  https://github.com/aiden0z/pptx-renderer
- SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3 — Apache License 2.0
  https://git.sheetjs.com/sheetjs/sheetjs

The build script also copies the upstream license texts into
OfficeAssets/licenses/ in the final application bundle.
